Hi Pete / Sarah / Orchid team —

Thanks for the interest in a hands-on walkthrough of Redwood Inference. We had a few discovery calls that lined up nicely and wanted to offer an option to combine Acumen Health, BrightLayer, and Orchid Retail into a single group demo (45–60m) so everyone sees a cross-industry set of examples and we can cover common patterns (routing, latency/cost tradeoffs, private deployment considerations).

Proposed evening options (PT):
- Thu Oct 14, 5:30–6:30pm PT
- Thu Oct 14, 7:00–8:00pm PT
- Fri Oct 15, 4:00–5:00pm PT

If one of those works, we’ll:
- Run a 25–30m shared demo (Host: me)
- Break into two 15m rooms for company-specific Q&A / quick PoC notes (Ben + Laura will lead breakouts)

If it’s easier, we can run a group demo + schedule 1:1 follow-ups instead of breakouts. I’ve attached a short agenda and a calendar file with the slot proposals.

Agenda (attached): quick intro, model routing use case, latency vs. cost tuning, deployment modes, QA + next steps.

Would love a quick yes/no on the slots or any alternate evening times that work for you.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks, Sofia —

Appreciate the consolidation offer. Two quick things from BrightLayer’s side:
1) Our engineering team is on Eastern time; 7:00pm PT (10pm ET) is rough for them — would you consider an earlier window (4:30pm PT / 7:30pm ET) instead of the later option?
2) For the breakout, we’d prefer a short private slot rather than a public Q&A; can Ben handle a quick readout on integrations?

If Oct 14 at 5:30pm PT can be nudged to 4:30pm PT, that’d be ideal. If not, we can do the group session and BrightLayer will book a 1:1.

—Sarah
